title: The case-collision disambiguator emits an unescaped _2 that the decoder reads as a nesting level
rationale: transformKeys calls generateUniqueKey AFTER encoding, and generateUniqueKey appends a raw separator with no escaping. Two case-variant fields fold to one name and the disambiguating suffix is parsed as structure. It also drags in setNestedValue _value wrapper, which invents a key that appears in no source document.
catchesBugClass: Uniquification suffixes emitted into an encoded namespace without escaping. The only fixture that exercises setNestedValue leaf/parent conflict wrapper.
cannotCatch: It cannot catch the same generateUniqueKey call made from sanitizeKey, which runs BEFORE encoding and produces a renamed-but-structurally-intact result - a materially different failure mode.

predicted.detail: Two scalars become one object with a fabricated _value key and a numeric-string key. Case folding is an ACCEPTED consequence of the requested strategy; the structural corruption and the invented _value are not.
